rawText: CHANGYU MOSER XV / MOSER FAMILY / CABERNET SAUVIGNON / 2022 / 宁夏贺兰山东麓产区 / NINGXIA HELAN MOUNTAIN EASTERN FOOTHILLS REGION
description: Changyu Moser XV is a joint venture between China's Changyu Group and Austrian winemaker Lenz Moser, established in Ningxia's Helan Mountain Eastern Foothills region, one of China's premier wine-growing areas known for its high altitude, sandy-gravel soils and continental climate. The estate focuses on Bordeaux varieties, with Cabernet Sauvignon being the flagship grape of the region.
